data.display_address: Lush at DAMAC Riverside, Dubai Investment Park 2 (DIP 2), Dubai Investment Park (DIP), Dubai
data.long_description:
Discover modern family living in this beautifully designed 4-bedroom villa located in the vibrant community of DAMAC Riverside. Offering a perfect blend of comfort, style, and nature-inspired surroundings, this home is ideal for families and investors alike.

Property Details:

4 Spacious Bedrooms
3 Modern Bathrooms
Built-Up Area: 143.99 sqm
Bright and airy living & dining area
Contemporary open-plan kitchen
Private garden space
Covered parking
Key Features:
Modern architectural design with high-quality finishes
Floor-to-ceiling windows for natural light
Smart layout maximizing space and functionality
Ideal for end-users and investors
Peaceful waterfront-inspired community
Amenities:

Swimming pools
Fully equipped gymnasium
Landscaped parks and green spaces
Kids’ play areas
Jogging and cycling tracks
BBQ areas
Community retail outlets
24/7 security and gated access
Nearby Locations:

Easy access to Al Yalayis Street & major highways
15–20 minutes to Dubai Marina
20 minutes to Expo City Dubai
25 minutes to Downtown Dubai
Close to Al Maktoum International Airport
Why Choose DAMAC Riverside?
DAMAC Riverside offers a serene lifestyle surrounded by water features and greenery while maintaining easy access to key destinations in Dubai. It’s the perfect balance between tranquility and urban convenience.
